rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Hive Secrets provides production encrypted credential storage for autonomous agents, isolating each agent DID into its own namespace so no cross-agent sharing is possible. Secrets are encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM with fresh cryptographic material per record. Operations include reading, writing, and audit logging, all metered via USDC settlement on Base L2. Offers both HTTP endpoints and MCP JSON-RPC interfaces.
